representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape bundle (entity-hierarchy: many/high-hierarchy/high-density, object=entity) is matched exactly: persistent left tree of 4 centers/13 depts with per-node counts (screenshots 1280x860 & 1440x900; source/index.html:246-252), dominant dense 196-row entity table (source/index.html:133,269-280), batch tray as single op entry (source/index.html:284-299). Success criterion 'batch ops with zero collateral, explicit state attribution' is architecturally central (selection as explicit id Set, source/index.html:324; source/app-core.js:105-162).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen at both viewports is dominated by the entity table (~70% of area) with the batch-action tray permanently visible at bottom (screenshots 1280x860, 1440x900; source/index.html:285-299); header states '设备资产工作台 批量管理 · 共 196 台设备' (screenshot 1280x860 top bar; source/index.html:239-240).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: what/where is conveyed instantly — app title + global counts (screenshot 1280x860 appbar), column headers 编号/设备名称/型号/状态/归属路径, status chips with counts 全部196/在用105/…, tree labeled with explicit interaction hint '点击名称＝定位过滤（不选中）·「选 N」＝显式加入选中集' (source/index.html:249); no loading state, data ready synchronously (source/seed.js:2,134; source/index.html:887-889).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object reachable in 0 steps: rows render on load at both viewports (screenshots). All reach/act paths are 1–2 clicks within one page: tree locate (source/index.html:738-741), explicit subtree select (source/index.html:742-748), batch op = select → tray button → snapshot confirm dialog (source/index.html:603-614, 696-699). No modes or route changes exist (single static page, source/index.html:302).

context_loss.evidence: Structure actively preserves context: filters/locate change only visibility, never selection (source/app-core.js:69-103); hidden-but-selected entities are counted and warned in tray and dialog with a 'reveal' remedy (source/index.html:514-526, 648-653); dialog binds an id snapshot at open so later selection changes cannot alter scope (source/index.html:605-611); full undo restores exact snapshots (source/app-core.js:164-173); receipt reports confirmed vs affected vs skipped counts (source/index.html:567-578).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces (appbar/tree/toolbar/table/tray/footer) each serve the manage job and receipt+dialog are hidden until needed (source/index.html:238-309); but control density exceeds minimal need — every tree row carries both a total-count badge and a '选 N' select button (source/index.html:409-412) duplicating '＋ 全选可见' (source/index.html:262), plus three permanent hint/micro-copy blocks (source/index.html:249, 291, 302). Screenshots show all of these simultaneously at 1280x860 and 1440x900.

accessibility.evidence: Four of five failed receipt checks are a11y checks: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks). Source corroborates: 14px checkboxes (source/index.html:150), 18px caret buttons (source/index.html:81), 11px badges/11.5px headers/11px footer text in #9ca3af (source/index.html:88,138,228). Some good faith effort exists (focus-visible outline source/index.html:32, aria-labels source/index.html:261,406,484,489, aria-live source/index.html:266,285), but measured failures are systematic, hence not higher.

frontend_rework.evidence: layout.overflow=pass and text.truncation=pass with no visible defect at either viewport (screenshots 1280x860, 1440x900); target_invalid=false and no error-failure checks in receipt (measurement-summary.json). Only defect signal is layout.responsive_collision=fail with 1 warning (measurement-summary.json checks), implying at most minor rework; also CSS comment claims WCAG-AA status-badge contrast (source/index.html:17) while a11y.contrast failed — a correctness-vs-receipt mismatch.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '批量选择与操作零误伤，状态归属显式' is addressed in source and UI: explicit id-set selection independent of view (source/index.html:322-324; source/app-core.js:113-162), idempotent skip reporting ('N 项已在目标状态/归属，未改动' source/index.html:576-577; preview source/index.html:656-666), scrap-device move blocked with explicit error + remediation (source/index.html:669-678), status attribution explicit per row via inline select and colored status chips with counts (screenshots; source/index.html:489-494), and an in-browser assertion suite naming the seed (source/tests/run-tests.html:26, T1 asserts 196 entities source/tests/run-tests.html:79).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast fail, a11y.focus_order fail, a11y.target_size fail, type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json checks; 4 of 7 checks)
layout.responsive_collision fail with 1 warning (measurement-summary.json checks), though layout.overflow and text.truncation pass
Sub-AA-size type throughout: body 13px, badges 11px, table headers 11.5px, footer 11px #9ca3af (source/index.html:27,88,138,228)
Sub-24px targets: 14px row checkboxes (source/index.html:150) and 18px tree caret buttons (source/index.html:81), visible in both screenshots
CSS token comment asserts WCAG AA contrast for status badges (source/index.html:17) but the measured a11y.contrast check failed — unverified claim
scores.overall_note: The package is a single-page hierarchical entity manager that matches the brief's shape bundle almost exactly: a 196-row dense entity table as the dominant region, a center/dept tree for locate-vs-select, and a permanent selection tray feeding snapshot-bound batch dialogs with undo (source/index.html:238-309, source/app-core.js:105-173). The acceptance seed is structurally enforced — selection is an explicit id set that filters cannot alter, hidden selections are counted and warned, idempotent skips are reported separately, and scrap devices block moves with an explicit error — and an in-browser assertion suite names the seed directly (source/tests/run-tests.html:26). Weaknesses are concentrated in receipt-measured quality: 5 of 7 checks fail, four of them a11y-related (contrast, focus_order, target_size, min projected type size), corroborated by 11px/13px type and 14–18px controls in source and screenshots, plus one responsive_collision failure with no visible defect at the two captured viewports. Functional and representational fit is excellent; accessibility is the clear deficit. This is a model-judged blind review; no human-preference, timing, or retrieval data exists in this pilot.
